glosses: Relating to, or based on, practice or action rather than theory or hypothesis.

examples.text: Jack didn't get an engineering degree, but has practical knowledge of metalworking.

glosses: Being likely to be effective and applicable to a real situation; able to be put to use.

examples.text: Jack's knowledge has the practical benefit of giving us useful prototype parts.
Recruits will be taught in-depth electrical and mechanical engineering as well as gaining practical experience in rail maintenance.

glosses: Of a person, having skills or knowledge that are practical.

examples.text: All in all, Jack's a very practical chap.

glosses: Of a prop: having some degree of functionality, rather than being a mere imitation.

examples.text: Practicals are used onstage as they would be used in real life. If the sound cue is to be from a radio or television, give qualities to the recording that will maintain the sense of the medium.

examples.text: A naturalistic set is normally dressed with all the furnishings and props to be found in a real room. This includes electric light fittings which, when they actually light, are known as practicals.

examples.text: Biorąc pod uwagę ogólną sytuację gospodarczą, nie jesteśmy w stanie uzyskać praktycznego wzrostu dochodów firmy.

examples.text: Och, mein neuer Freund ist sehr praktisch veranlagt.
